findings.title: Arrival closes preparation
findings.claim: The focus arrival can be heard as the event that closes the interval in which preparation could still be sent ahead: remembrance returns afterward, while the wished-for advance is already late.
findings.mechanism: The focus occurrence 89:22:1:2 is followed by remembrance at 89:23:5 and 89:23:9, due-time pressure at 89:23:7, and the regretful advance at 89:24:3 serving the life occurrence at 89:24:4. The later context turns coming into a temporal boundary for useful preparation.
findings.reader_payoff: The arrival is not only the announcement that judgment is present; it marks the moment after which knowledge can return without recovering the missed act.
findings.containment: The ordinary arrival reading remains. The temporal-foreclosure arrow is a medium-strength attributed inference, and the packet preserves the alternative that regret simply follows judgment narratively without defining the force of جاء.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace supplies exact focus/context coordinates, roles, and the repeated time marker's surrounding sequence; the closure of preparation is explicitly attributed inference.

findings.title: Advent opens a return corridor
findings.claim: The focus advent can frame two opposed trajectories: compelled presentation toward judgment and a later calm, mutually accepted return through ordered ranks into belonging and shelter.
findings.mechanism: The focus arrival at 89:22:1:2 and Lord-title at 89:22:2:1 meet later calm at 89:27:3, return at 89:28:1, mutual satisfaction at 89:28:4 and 89:28:5, and successive entries at 89:29:1 and 89:30:2. The focus ranks supply an ordered host that can be read as perimeter or reception corridor.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus rows remain a judgment assembly while also becoming the ordered threshold through which the later accepted self moves homeward.
findings.containment: The later address is kept in the supplied pericope and does not establish a surah-wide channel here. The packet's live alternative is that the rows remain exclusively judicial and the final address begins a separate scene; both directions remain visible.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace supplies exact later context coordinates and attributed roles; the corridor relation joining the focus rows to the later return is an explicit qualified inference.

findings.title: Elevation levelled into presence
findings.claim: A qualified vertical resonance places raised ground and increased elevation beside the focus's level field: claimed height is lowered into a form of presence that can settle rather than exalt itself.
findings.mechanism: The supplied split mapping gives elevation and raised-ground carriers at 89:22:2:1, while 89:21:3, 89:21:5, and 89:21:6 supply lowering and spreading, 89:22:4:1 and 89:22:5:1 supply level-ground imagery, and 89:27:3 supplies later calm. Their contact creates a vertical-to-horizontal and unrest-to-settling movement.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus advent can be held alongside an image in which true presence appears after claimed elevations have been levelled, while the primary scene remains intact.
findings.containment: The elevation image comes from the packet's non-dominant split mapping under the focus root, not from the surface word رب itself. It is exploratory attributed evidence and is rendered as a bounded resonance about elevation and level presence, not as a gloss for ربك.

epistemic.reason: The HFT outlier supplies exact coordinates and roles but explicitly qualifies the split-root mapping and the vertical phase arrow as exploratory.
